title: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.

synonyms: Toumei na Yoru ni Kakeru Kimi to, Me ni Mienai Koi wo Shita.
Gokusai no Yoru ni Kakeru-kun to, Menimienai Koi wo Shita.
I Fell in Love with You, Who Ran Through the Transparent Night, A Love that was Invisible
alternative_titles.en: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
alternative_titles.ja: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。

synopsis:
Koharu Fuyutsuki is a university student who refuses to let her blindness define her life. Her infectious optimism soon draws the attention of the withdrawn Kakeru Sorano, whose guarded outlook on the world slowly begins to change after meeting her.

As their bond deepens, the two navigate the everyday challenges that accompany Koharu's condition, discovering that genuine understanding comes not from seeing with one's eyes, but from learning to see another person's heart.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
